patterns.note: Content is presented in distinct, generously spaced blocks, often centered within the viewport, creating an airy and structured flow.

A sophisticated, condensed serif font is used for prominent headings and titles, providing an elegant and classic feel, sharply contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.

A warm, golden-brown accent color is consistently applied to key headings, call-to-action buttons, and the footer background, establishing a luxurious and inviting brand identity against light backgrounds.
Content sections, including image grids and text blocks, animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as the user scrolls down the page, enhancing content discovery.
Each major content area is introduced by a large, centered heading in the accent color, clearly delineating sections and guiding the user's eye through the page.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the page, ensuring constant access to key links. Content sections are revealed using GSAP ScrollTrigger, animating into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
The hero section features a full-bleed, immersive background image with minimal, elegant text overlay, establishing the site's aesthetic immediately upon load.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant display serif for hero and main section titles (~3-4x body) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on cards and buttons).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and breathing room).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its elegant fusion of classic, ornate interior photography with a clean, modern web layout. The consistent use of a specific, refined serif font for titles, paired with a warm golden accent color, creates a luxurious and sophisticated brand presence that feels both timeless and contemporary.
